verdict.rationale: Docs repeatedly confirm Pinecone's core product is 'serverless indexes' (multitenancy, backups, etc.), implying no fixed cluster provisioning, and a community comment notes a generous usage-based free tier that scales with data volume. However, no evidence pack item shows an actual pricing page, per-unit cost breakdown, or explicit usage-based billing metrics (e.g. per-read/write-unit pricing table). Missing for 10: explicit pricing documentation with transparent per-unit rates, independent commentary on cost predictability/billing accuracy.
